meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne-prone skin ke liye ₹700 ke andar serum choose karte waqt sabse pehle yeh dekho ki tumhe **active pimples, blackheads, ya pimples ke baad ke dark spots** mein se kiski problem zyada hai.

- **Salicylic acid (1–2%)** — clogged pores, blackheads aur oily skin ke liye.
- **Niacinamide (4–5%)** — oil control aur acne ke baad ke marks ke liye.
- **Azelaic acid** — pimples ke saath redness aur dark marks ke liye bhi useful ho sakta hai.

Naya serum dheere-dheere start karna, pehle patch test karna aur din mein SPF 30+ sunscreen lagana achha rahega.
